description_en: Queries synchronization tasks in the new version of Data Integration, including full-database real-time synchronization tasks, full-database batch synchronization tasks, and single-table real-time synchronization tasks
description_zh: 查询数据集成新版任务列表，包括整库同步实时任务，整库同步离线任务，单表同步实时任务等数据集成任务
name: ListDIJobs

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的数据条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The name of the export task.

The name must be unique within the current DataWorks workspace. Duplicate names are not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
导出任务的名称。

名称必须唯一，即当前DataWorks工作空间中不能存在名称重复的导出任务
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the source data source. If you do not specify this parameter, no limit is applied. Valid values: PolarDB, MySQL, Kafka, LogHub, Hologres, Oracle, OceanBase, MongoDB, RedShift, Hive, SQLServer, Doris, and ClickHouse
parameters.help_zh: 源端数据源类型，不填代表不限制，枚举值：PolarDB，MySQL，Kafka，LogHub，Hologres，Oracle，OceanBase，MongoDB，RedShift，Hive，SQLServer，Doris，ClickHouse
parameters.name: source_data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the destination data source. If you do not specify this parameter, no limit is applied. Valid values: Hologres, OSS-HDFS, OSS, MaxCompute, LogHub, StarRocks, DataHub, AnalyticDB_For_MySQL, Kafka, and Hive
parameters.help_zh: 目标端数据源类型，不填代表不限制，枚举值：Hologres，OSS-HDFS，OSS，MaxCompute，LogHub，StarRocks，DataHub，AnalyticDB_For_MySQL，Kafka，Hive
parameters.name: destination_data_source_type

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:
FullAndRealtimeIncremental: full and real-time incremental synchronization
RealtimeIncremental: real-time incremental synchronization
Full: full synchronization
OfflineIncremental: batch incremental synchronization
FullAndOfflineIncremental: full and batch incremental synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步类型，可选的枚举值有：
FullAndRealtimeIncremental（全量和实时增量）
RealtimeIncremental（实时增量）
Full（全量）
OfflineIncremental（离线增量）
FullAndOfflineIncremental（全量+离线增量）
parameters.name: migration_type

parameters.help_en: The task configuration specification type. Valid values: FILESPEC, CLASSIC, and ALL. FILESPEC: new-version tasks based on structured filespec. CLASSIC: tasks in the traditional configuration mode
parameters.help_zh: 任务配置规范类型。可选FILESPEC、CLASSIC、ALL。FILESPEC：基于结构化 filespec 的新版任务；CLASSIC：传统配置模式的任务；
parameters.name: spec_type

DIJobId.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is deprecated. Use the Id field instead
DIJobId.description_zh: 该字段已废弃，请使用Id字段

DestinationDataSourceType.description_en: The type of the destination data source. Valid values: Hologres, OSS-HDFS, OSS, MaxCompute, Loghub, STARROCKS, DataHub, ANALYTICDB_FOR_MYSQL, Kafka, and Hive

Id.description_en: The ID of the data integration task

JobStatus.description_en:
The synchronization status. Valid values:
Finished: finished successfully
Initialized: initialized
Stopped: stopped
Failed: failed
Running: running
Stopping: stopping
JobStatus.description_zh:
同步状态，可选的枚举值：
Finished（运行成功已结束）
Initialized（初始化完成）
Stopped（已停止）
Failed（运行失败）
Running（运行中）
Stopping（停止中）

MigrationType.description_en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:
FullAndRealtimeIncremental: full and real-time incremental synchronization
RealtimeIncremental: real-time incremental synchronization
Full: full synchronization
OfflineIncremental: batch incremental synchronization
FullAndOfflineIncremental: full and batch incremental synchronization
MigrationType.description_zh:
同步类型，可选的枚举值有：
FullAndRealtimeIncremental（全量和实时增量）
RealtimeIncremental（实时增量）
Full（全量）
OfflineIncremental（离线增量）
FullAndOfflineIncremental（全量+离线增量）

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the task belongs

SourceDataSourceType.description_en: The type of the source data source. Valid values: PolarDB, MySQL, Kafka, Loghub, Hologres, Oracle, OceanBase, MongoDB, RedShift, Hive, SqlServer, Doris, and ClickHouse

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned data
PageNumber.description_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件的数据总条数
